evals.name: existing-orm-8-stale-guidance
evals.source: Synthetic requirement check: refresh package-owned guidance without reinitializing an existing application.
evals.prompt: Our PostgreSQL application already uses @prisma/orm-postgres@8.0.0-rc.11 and prisma@8.0.0-rc.15. Its contract, database connection, and application queries already work. The copied prisma-8 skill says metadata.library_version is 8.0.0-rc.10. Help us check the ORM setup before further development. Describe your next steps only; do not install packages, call external services, or change files.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the configured ORM 8 app and database; refresh and read guidance matching the installed ORM library, then verify application behavior.
expectations: Preserves the existing application configuration and database without rerunning ORM initialization or provisioning another database.
Plans prisma skills sync followed by reading the refreshed prisma-8 skill and matching metadata.library_version to @prisma/orm-postgres@8.0.0-rc.11, not the independently versioned CLI.
Plans application checks and a read-only query without claiming those checks have already run.

evals.name: legacy-client-with-new-cli
evals.source: Synthetic requirement check: CLI 8 does not make an existing Prisma 7 app an ORM 8 app.
evals.prompt: We installed prisma@8.0.0-rc.15, but our PostgreSQL app still imports @prisma/client@7.10.0 and uses prisma/schema.prisma. The intended database is connected. Finish the ORM setup, but I have not approved a major application upgrade. Describe your next steps only; do not install packages, call external services, or change files.
evals.expected_output: Recognize the legacy application despite its CLI version, stop setup at an upgrade proposal, and reference the applicable Prisma migration documentation.
expectations: Identifies this as a Prisma 7 or mixed application based on the client and schema, rather than treating CLI 8 as proof of an ORM 8 application.
Pauses setup at an upgrade proposal and preserves dependencies, schema, configuration, and data until migration is authorized; does not propose completing legacy setup.

Uses an applicable discovered upgrade workflow or Prisma's ORM 7-to-8 PostgreSQL migration guide, without inventing a skill or using prisma-upgrade-v7 or the prisma-8 release-update reference as a 7-to-8 migration.

evals.name: check-provider-support
evals.source: Synthetic requirement check: verify ORM 8 provider support before setup and preserve the requested database.
evals.prompt: Set up Prisma ORM for our Node application. We already have a MySQL database and no ORM installed. Keep MySQL and the existing database; changing providers is out of scope. We have not checked which Prisma ORM 8 release supports our provider and runtime. Describe your next steps only; do not install packages, call external services, or change files.
evals.expected_output: Check the selected ORM 8 release's documented provider and runtime support before installation. If unsupported or unverified, explain the blocker without switching database or falling back to Prisma 7.
expectations: Plans to verify provider and runtime support for a selected Prisma ORM 8 release before installing or initializing it, rather than assuming Prisma 7 provider coverage carries over.
Preserves MySQL and the existing database; does not switch to PostgreSQL or provision a replacement.
Does not fall back to Prisma 7 or invent a supported initialization target; reports a blocker if support cannot be established.
